reasons: Five required 4-MC courses total 20 MC, but semesters 7-8 allow at most 16 MC at 8 MC per semester.
CS4226 is Sem1-only and must pair with CS3230 in semester 7, filling it; CS3236 and CS3234 are Sem2-only, filling semester 8, so CS2102 cannot fit.
CS3223 in semester 8 would also require CS2102 in an earlier semester, which is impossible under the 8 MC cap.
